name: Buyer Protection Instruction
definition: Instruction submitted by the buyer of a financial instrument involved in a pending settlement transaction, requesting the seller (who is the holder on record) to act on their behalf in a voluntary corporate action. This instruction ensures the buyer’s election is executed despite not being the legal holder at record date.

BuyerProtectionInstructionIdentification.name: Buyer Protection Instruction Identification
BuyerProtectionInstructionIdentification.definition: Buyer Protection instruction identification assigned by the CSD when an instruction has been entered by the buyer.
